copy.intro: Work with a team, take responsibility, and see how an organisation runs. BMD internships connect classroom study with supervised workplace experience.

copy.notebook_note: Feedback, shared tasks, and time with volunteers were part of the learning.
copy.service_intro: Prepare supplies, coordinate roles, and serve each person with respect.
copy.yoyogi_body: Interns prepared ingredients, served meals, and collected plates alongside local volunteers.

copy.takeaway_body: The experience connected project planning, limited resources, and cross-cultural communication with a simple responsibility: do the work carefully and treat people with respect.
copy.prepare_intro: The department publishes internship rules, planning forms, agreements, and evaluation documents. Use the official resources for your course and placement.

copy.sources_body: The Tokyo feature is edited from a participant’s 2026 internship journal and presentation. Its activities and daily schedule describe that placement. Participant photographs are used alongside the department’s meal-preparation photograph; the full personal journal is not published here. Preparation guidance is based on official BMD internship publications.

translations.Work with a team, take responsibility, a: 與團隊合作、承擔責任，也看見組織如何運作。經管系實習讓學生在指導下走進工作現場，把課堂所學帶入實務。
translations.Tzu Chi Japan · Summer 2026: 慈濟日本分會・2026 年夏季
在工作與服務之間，累積經驗。
translations.A usual office day ran from 09:00 to 17:: 平日辦公時間通常為 09:00–17:00，工作隨當天活動與服務需求調整。此作息為本次東京實習的經驗。
從一件件小事，學會負責。
translations.A receipt needs the right category. A su: 一張收據要分對類別，一句字幕要對準時間。每天的任務，讓細心、溝通與合作變成具體的練習。
translations.Feedback, shared tasks, and time with vo: 與志工一起分工、接受回饋，也是實習的一部分。
從備餐，到把餐點送到手中。
translations.Service put management into a human sett: 服務現場讓管理有了人的溫度：準備物資、協調人手、維持流程，也留意眼前每一位服務對象的感受。
translations.Interns helped prepare ingredients, tran: 實習生協助備料、搬運物資、發放餐點與回收餐盤。和當地志工合作時，除了讓流程順暢，也練習以親切、尊重的態度迎接每一位領餐者。
translations.A community visit involved dividing indo: 居家關懷服務依工作需求分成室內清潔與戶外除草。從事前備妥工具，到互相支援、整理環境，團隊合作就在這些細節中完成。
translations.Read the department’s Yoyogi report: 閱讀系所代代木服務報導
translations.Disaster-prevention practice, tea cultur: 防災體驗、茶道與志工活動，讓實習多了另一種學習。學生在不熟悉的環境中，透過聆聽、提問與親自嘗試，逐步適應不同的生活與文化。
做事有效率，也懂得體諒。
translations.The experience connected project plannin: 這段經驗把專案規劃、有限資源的運用與跨文化溝通，連結到一份實際的責任：把事情做好，也尊重每一個人。
translations.For your own placement: 為自己的實習做好準備

translations.Make a message clear in another language: 讓訊息跨越語言，也保留原意。
translations.Mandarin talks by Master Cheng Yen were: 將證嚴上人的中文開示整理成逐字稿、翻譯為日文，再製作字幕。過程中需要分段剪輯、調整時間軸，並反覆確認語意與閱讀節奏；訪談內容也整理成海報素材。
translations.Transcription · Japanese translation · S: 逐字稿・日文翻譯・字幕剪輯・海報製作
translations.Cross-cultural communication, careful li: 跨文化溝通、聆聽與資訊表達。
安排好工作，也照顧好人。
translations.Meal preparation, bento packing, activit: 備餐、分裝便當、布置活動與社區關懷，都需要清楚分工。實習生與志工合作，配合當天需求調整，也協助活動後的收拾與整理。
translations.Food preparation · Service flow · Suppli: 備餐・服務流程・物資準備・團隊協調
translations.Resource allocation, practical problem s: 資源分配、現場應變與尊重他人的服務態度。
在不熟悉的環境中，慢慢成長。
translations.Tea ceremony, omamori making, disaster-p: 茶道、御守製作、防災體驗與健康活動，讓學生接觸日本文化及志工社群的日常。面對新的任務，從請教、練習到逐漸獨立完成，也建立了適應力。
translations.Cultural activities · Safety practice ·: 文化活動・防災練習・志工交流
translations.Adaptability, confidence, and awareness: 適應力、自信，以及理解不同工作與生活方式的能力。

translations.Complete the required agreement and insu: 完成規定的合約與保險安排，參與行前說明。實習期間持續記錄工作，並和機構督導及系所輔導老師保持聯繫。

work.label: Office & finance
work.title: Receipts, records & files.
work.body: Sort and enter receipts, count coins, prepare mail, organise files, and make presentations.
work.skills: Accuracy, basic financial administration, and time management.

work.label: Translation & media
work.title: From Mandarin to Japanese.
work.body: Transcribe Master Cheng Yen’s talks, translate into Japanese, edit subtitles, and turn interviews into posters.
work.tasks: Transcription · Japanese translation · Subtitle editing · Posters
work.skills: Cross-cultural communication, careful listening, and presenting information for an audience.

work.label: Service & operations
work.title: Preparing, serving, organising.
work.body: Prepare meals, pack bento, set up activities, and support community visits with volunteers.
work.tasks: Food preparation · Service flow · Supplies · Team coordination
work.skills: Resource allocation, practical problem solving, and respectful service.

work.label: Culture & independence
work.title: Tea, crafts & safety.
work.body: Tea ceremony, omamori making, safety practice, and health activities offered experience beyond office work.
work.tasks: Cultural activities · Safety practice · Volunteer interaction
work.skills: Adaptability, confidence, and awareness of different ways of working.

preparation.title: Agree on a learning plan
preparation.body: Before starting, confirm the placement and prepare an individual learning plan with the department and host. The department reviews placements and the plan before the internship begins.

preparation.title: Prepare, then stay in touch
preparation.body: Complete the required agreement and insurance arrangements, and attend the pre-departure briefing. During the placement, keep records and stay in contact with your host supervisor and department adviser.

preparation.title: Review the experience
preparation.body: Complete the required assignments and evaluation documents, then review your learning with the department. Course hours, credits, and assessment follow the official rules for your placement.
